{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Broken Jaw''''' was the personal [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Clabburn the Younger]]. It was a modified [[IrizMark-8 Sentinel-class Military Cruiser|IrizMark-8 ''Sentinel''-class military cruiser]]. It was outfitted with two [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], a pair of assault [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generators. Because of its small size, ''Broken Jaw'' was often escorted by larger craft. It made up for its size, however, with excellent maneuverability and speed. The ship could hold up to forty pirates and 8,000 tons of cargo.
